name: off-by-one
description: Reporting utilities that paginate transaction lists and total their amounts into a plain-text report.

bugs.description: The loop condition uses i <= nums.length, so the final iteration reads nums[nums.length] (undefined) and corrupts the total with NaN; the bound should be i < nums.length.
end is computed as start + size + 1, so items.slice returns one item more than the requested page size.
